# Security Policy

Security-related corrections are applied to the current `main` branch. Older copies, forks, archives, and third-party deployments are not actively supported.

Do not publish exploit details, credentials, personal data, or sensitive evidence in a public issue. Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting feature when enabled; otherwise contact the owner through the [GitHub profile](https://github.com/samusa099).

Include the affected file or component, reproduction steps, potential impact, environment details, and a suggested mitigation when available.

Relevant reports include exposed secrets, unsafe data handling, vulnerable dependencies, cross-site scripting, unsafe redirects, malicious asset loading, and risky repository configuration.

Do not access data that is not yours, disrupt services, or test systems without explicit authorisation. The target is to acknowledge a valid report within seven days and provide a correction or mitigation when practical.
